about.bio: I am Adwaith V, a BSc Computer Science student passionate about full-stack development and cybersecurity.
about.paragraph2: My technical journey bridges secure software engineering with modern web architecture — building resilient platforms like CyberSafeHub and Auralis, and translating complex security logic into intuitive, high-performance interfaces.

achievements.text: Creator of CyberSafeHub — a full-stack cybersecurity platform with malware scanning & breach detection.
Built Auralis — a modern music streaming platform with waveform visualization & crossfade engine.
Proficient in React, Node.js, Python, MongoDB, PostgreSQL & cybersecurity tooling.
